caption: The drawing depicts two technical views of an object resembling a candlestick holder. The background of the image is an off-white, slightly yellowed color, suggesting aged paper. The lines are fine and appear to be drawn in black or dark gray ink. The upper part of the drawing shows a side elevation with a cylindrical central holder mounted on a wide, flat, circular base that flares outward and features symmetrical grooves underneath. Extending horizontally from the base on the left side is a curved handle with a small upward curl at its end. A vertical slot and round peg mechanism is visible on the upper part of the stem. The lower half of the drawing presents a top-down view of the same object, where the circular base is seen in its entirety, with a hexagonal and round pattern in the center, possibly indicating structural details. Five straight lines radiate from the center toward the circumference. The handle is visible as a straight horizontal extension from the left side of the circle. At the bottom left, a small, finely marked scale is present, labeled in inches. The entire composition is rendered with precision and lacks color except for the monochrome lines and paper tones.
title: Candlestick
